# Bookshop

A tiny online bookshop backend used as a fixture for retrieval tests.

- `bookshop/auth.py`: password hashing and signed session tokens
- `bookshop/cart.py`: shopping cart and coupons
- `bookshop/inventory.py`: stock reservations and reorder report
- `bookshop/payments.py`: card payments and refunds
- `bookshop/orders.py`: order lifecycle
- `bookshop/notifications.py`: customer emails
- `web/app.js`: browser helpers
